description: Examines the secret Stargate program as an institutional and democratic problem: Kinsey’s oversight challenge, rogue NID theft, Hammond’s removal, international disclosure and Hayes’s presidential briefing.

related_resources.reason: Kinsey’s initial oversight challenge and SGC budget dispute.
The theft from Madrona and the second Stargate.
O’Neill’s covert work exposing off-world theft and its cost to team trust.
Threat to Hammond’s granddaughters; resignation, Jack and Maybourne, General Bauer’s hazardous bomb test, reinstatement.
International briefing, Kinsey’s NID bid, Thor and the Prometheus offer.
Woolsey’s review of command decisions and President Hayes’s scrutiny of SG-1.
February 13, 2004 air date, Cooper/Mikita credits; Bregman and SG-13; presidential documentary commission and production testimony.
The Antarctic dispute and the System Lords’ recognition of Earth’s Ancient defense.
